description:
Overview: T900 Pro Max is an affordable smartwatch with a 1.69 inch HD full-touch display, aimed at users who want a blend of style, basic health tracking and everyday connectivity on the wrist. It pairs with compatible Android and iOS phones to show notifications and support Bluetooth calling.

Display & Watch Faces: The 1.69 inch screen provides a clear view of watch faces, menus and notifications. With 100+ dials and multiple menu styles, you can adjust the look and interface to match your preferences.

Health & Fitness: The watch offers real-time heart rate monitoring, sleep tracking and breathing exercises for general wellness awareness. It also includes multiple sports or activity modes to log daily movement and workouts, though readings from such devices should not be treated as medical data.

Connectivity & Calling: Bluetooth connectivity enables call-related functions such as dial and receive from the watch when it is paired with your phone, helping you handle quick conversations and alerts without reaching for your device.

Durability & Usage: IP68-rated water resistance makes the smartwatch suitable for everyday splashes, sweat and typical outdoor use within the stated limits. Combined with an optimized power consumption system, it is intended for regular daily wear across work, travel and light exercise.
